alerts.dashboardText: The US Commerce Department has lifted export controls on Fable 5 and Mythos 5. Fable 5 access resumes globally today on Claude.ai, Claude Code, and Cowork; Mythos 5 is restored for approved US organizations. On Pro, Max, Team, and select Enterprise plans, Fable 5 is included for up to 50% of your weekly usage limits through July 7 — after that it draws on usage credits. Tap to read Anthropic's statement.

alerts.text: Claude Sonnet 5 is here — intro pricing through Aug 31
alerts.dashboardText: Claude Sonnet 5 is now the default model on Free and Pro, and available on Max, Team, and Enterprise. Introductory pricing of $2/$10 per million input/output tokens runs through August 31, then moves to $3/$15. Note: Sonnet 5's new tokenizer can use up to 1.35× more tokens for the same text — pricing is calibrated to keep costs roughly cost-neutral. Tap to read more.
